scope: Pankeki user workflow and official competitive documentation research, followed by Live2D patterns

quality_all_requirements_passed.basis: shutdown-checkpoint.md historical assessment; not rescored all 9 by this researcher

observations.fact: Chat send disabled with disconnected status; detailed settings route exists.
Candidate parentId is image-version provenance, not a live deformation hierarchy.
Exported requests omit source/mask; import resets mask and warns to repaint.
Compare captions show candidate/kind/seed; no structured requirement review fields in current strict v1 schema.
observations.source: web/src/app.js compare handler and web/src/profiles.js candidate/project

observations.fact: Board uses current project brief; candidates retain their own generation brief.

hypothesis.claim: Source + edit target + up to three manual criteria improve correct next-action decisions and avoid false completion.
hypothesis.followup: Coordinator owns cross-product synthesis and validation priority after scope reduction; no pilot performed
